_comment: Hand-kept fixes for gaps in the sources. Not catch paths, windows or weather: those follow Carbuncle Plushy or Teamcraft as written. Each entry notes its source.

2412.name: Shirogane
2412.source: Housing district added in patch 4.1 (Stormblood); TerritoryType.ExVersion says ARR

7923.name: Sweetnewt
7923.source: Estimate: highest requirement among patch 2.3 (Defenders of Eorzea) big fish (335-380; patches from GatherBuddy). Own number unknown: no number on the wiki, Teamcraft or its live stats; also not on Garland Tools or ff14angler (checked 2026-11-04)
